name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away from the machine in a staggered stance.
Hold one rope end in each hand behind your head with your torso leaned slightly forward and elbows pointing up.
Straighten both elbows to press the rope forward and overhead until your arms extend.
Bend your elbows under control to return your hands behind your head.
tips: Keep your ribs down to limit arching through your lower back.
Keep your upper arms close to your head rather than letting your elbows flare wide.
